text:
sarah.h: Quick check — we need to finalize the key rotation strategy for the next cross-cloud roll (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault). Main asks: RBAC changes required, audit logging coverage, and fallback for a failed auto-rotation (manual rewrap).

michael.t: +1. Can you list the exact systems that will be affected? thinking: envelope encryption keys for backups, object storage, and token signing.

sarah.h: yep — backup service (s3/gcs/azblob), secrets-store, session-token-signing, and model artifacts. Also need to confirm our envelope header versioning will handle old ciphertexts.

kevin.p: RBAC: we'll need to add new service principals to each cloud KMS role before rotation and leave old principals during canary window. For AWS that means `kms:ReEncrypt*`, `kms:Encrypt`, `kms:Decrypt` scoped to the new CMK. For Azure/GCP similar.

emma.s: audit logging: ensure CloudTrail / Audit Logs include `ReEncrypt`/`Encrypt`/`Decrypt` events and are forwarded to our central SIEM with key-id and principal. We should add an alert on >0 failed decrypts from storage services during canary.

kevin.p: suggestion: staged canary across clusters 
- Canary 1: infra-only (control plane) 
- Canary 2: low-traffic prod shard 
- Canary 3: full rollout
Each stage 30–60m with health checks.

michael.t: fallback plan if auto-rotate fails? manual rewrap runbook?

sarah.h: yes — documented manual rewrap steps + a fast rollback to previous CMK in routing config. Manual rewrap should be idempotent and retryable.

kevin.p: Adding snippet for AWS re-encrypt we tested:
```
aws kms re-encrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://old_ct --destination-key-id arn:aws:kms:...:new-cmk --destination-encryption-context '{"purpose":"envelope"}' --output text > new_ct
```
note: make sure to hydrate and validate headers before replacing objects.

michael.t: GCP note: `gcloud kms keys versions create` rotates a key but doesn't rewrap existing ciphertexts automatically — need re-encrypt helper job.

emma.s: ops-bot: can we get a scheduled job template for rewrap that respects rate limits and emits per-object metric? @ops-bot

ops-bot: scheduled-job created: `rekey-reencrypt-v1` (dry-run mode default). Rate-limit 50 obj/s, concurrency 10. Logs to `rekey/audit`.

security-oncall: incident triage checklist: 
- If decrypt failures spike, pause rewrap and switch routing to previous key id.
- Collect failing ciphertext samples and headers.
- Run `validate-decryption` job in dry-run to identify incompatible objects.
- Notify customers if >5% of objects affected >30m.

sarah.h: backwards compatibility: envelope header must include `version` and `key-id` fields. New runtime must accept both v1 and v2 headers; v2 adds `alg` and `context`. We'll publish compatibility matrix.

kevin.p: question: do we rotate KEKs (master keys) automatically every 90 days or keep manual per-customer?

michael.t: default policy: auto-rotate KEK every 90d for hosted customers. For Dedicated/Private, rotation is configurable + manual rewrap opt-in. Need legal/compliance sign-off for forced rotates.

emma.s: observability: add token-level traces showing which key-id was used per request. Dashboard: decrypt latency, failed decrypt rate, rewrap throughput.

sarah.h: timeline proposal: week 1 — preflight (RBAC, SIEM piping, dry-run), week 2 — infra canary, week 3 — shard canaries, week 4 — full rollout + post-validate.

michael.t: agree. I'll file a short runbook and preflight checklist in Confluence: https://confluence.internal/redwood/kms-rotate-preflight (draft) :memo:

kevin.p: one more: ensure KMS key policy denies `ReEncrypt` from unknown principals to avoid accidental exfil during rewrap windows.

security-oncall: add automated check that key policies match expected template before proceeding with each stage. Fail-fast if mismatch.

sarah.h: perfect. action items: @kevin.p draft RBAC change PR, @emma.s add SIEM alerts + dashboard, @michael.t author runbook + legal touchpoint, I'll coordinate timeline and dry-run.

kevin.p: starting RBAC PR today. tagging infra-sre for review. :thumbsup:

michael.t: ping me once RBAC PR merged, I'll schedule preflight run.

sarah.h: thanks all — we'll reconvene after preflight results. :rocket:
